annotation.authors_or_issuer: Office of the Prime Minister, Government of Jamaica
annotation.venue: Office of the Prime Minister, Jamaica
annotation.summary_en: Jamaica's 2015 Government Communication Policy, issued by the Office of the Prime Minister. It sets principles and 20 policy elements for how ministries, departments and agencies communicate with the public, covering information access, branding, crisis communication, new media, social media and records management. It has no AI or robotics content despite the collector's title.
key_provisions_or_claims: Sets 20 policy elements for government communication, with objectives and strategies for each.
Requires MDAs to adopt new media platforms while keeping traditional channels for citizens without access.
Provides a crisis and emergency communication protocol (Appendix 6).
Requires proactive disclosure and public access to government information.
Includes social media guidelines and rules on government advertising and records management.
